changelog:
Initial release of the Huawei Cloud CCE Alarm Correlation Engine skill.

- Provides AOM alarm correlation and alarm-rule management for CCE operations.
- Supports querying active and historical alarms, analyzing deduplication, alarm storms, severity, and chronic alarms.
- Enables inspection of CCE alarm health and risk item generation.
- Allows query, creation, update, deletion, enable/disable of AOM alarm rules.
- Supports notification action rule management and batch configuration/cleanup of recommended alarm rules.
- Implements secure operations via a Python dispatcher with strict credential handling and permission checks.
summary: Huawei Cloud AOM alarm correlation and alarm-rule management skill for CCE operations. Use this skill when the user wants to: (1) query AOM active and historical alarms, (2) analyze alarm deduplication, alarm storms, severity grouping, burst alarms, and chronic alarms, (3) inspect CCE cluster alarm health, (4) query, create, update, delete, enable, or disable AOM alarm rules, (5) query or create notification action rules, (6) batch configure or clean CCE recommended AOM alarm rules from the cloud-side CCE alarm template. Trigger: user mentions "alarm correlation", "AOM alarm", "alarm rule", "alarm storm", "alarm inspection", "notification rule", "告警关联", "AOM 告警", "告警规则", "告警风暴", "通知规则", or "CCE 告警".
